rows.en: Sisk: "♪♪♪"
Rest: "...A-ahem!"
Sisk: "Mmm... His Highness's scent...♥"
Lodis: "H-hey, Sisk, stop that..."
Rest: "..."
Sisk: "Your Highness♥ Hehehehe!"
Lodis: "...Sigh."
Celica: "...Derock."
Derock: "Understood.
...Heave-ho."
Sisk: "Hey! What are you doing?! Let go of me!"
Derock: "You should do that when you're alone together, you know.
I'm sure His Majesty would prefer that too."
Sisk: "O-oh, right. Of course. Yeah. I'll do that."
Lodis: "No, that would be a problem too..."
Rest: "A-ahem! Your Majesty, perhaps you could explain the operation..."
Lodis: "Yes, of course. Our destination is ostensibly
an ordinary research facility, but we believe it's the center of
'Code 3' research. It's very likely to be armed.
Even if it isn't, charging into the facility in Spirit Mechs
would cause confusion. In the worst case,
they might even 'self-destruct' to destroy the evidence."
Touya: "...Hey, then
is there nothing we can do?"
Lodis: "That's why we'll attempt to enter the research facility
directly, with a small team."
Clovis: "That's another bold plan.
Are you calling in Agarthia's special forces?
I doubt you've brought them to the battlefield."
Lodis: "We don't have time to return to the capital.
I'll lead the team myself."
Clovis: "Whew!"
Arthur: "Isn't that a little too dangerous?
If that's the plan, then we could..."
Lodis: "Could you memorize the facility's entire layout
from this data, right now?"
Xiujian: "Oh... Data on the research facility's layout.
I hadn't realized he'd even given us this."
Arthur: "...It's quite a complicated layout...
I take some pride in my memory, but memorizing this
on the spot would be difficult."
Lodis: "There are other reasons, but that's another reason
I'm suited to this."
Touya: "...You mean you've memorized
this whole maze?"
Celica: "It's one of my brother's talents.
He can remember most things after seeing them once.
Though somehow he never remembers people's faces properly.
You used to get in trouble for trying to charm someone
you'd already tried to pick up before, didn't you...?"
Lodis: "C-Celica?!"
Celica: "Hehehehe! Anyway, Major Rest
will be with him, so we can leave it to them."
Touya: "Then what do the rest of us do?"
Lodis: "I'd like a few of you to come along.
The others should stand by in case anything happens."
Clovis: "Of course. Have you decided
who's going?"
Lodis: "Myself, Rest and Derock..."
Yamato: "What?!"
Derock: "Hehe! Covert operations like this are
my specialty. These 'secret photos of Princess Celica'
show my talents to the fullest, you know."
Touya: "Hm? Let me see..."
Celica: "Aaah!"
Derock: "O-ow... Oh, I'd like
those back, you know..."
Celica: "Hah... Hah... Honestly, I can't
let my guard down for a moment."
Derock: "It's all right, though.
I can just make more prints. Ghehehehe!"
Celica: "Y-you..."
Lodis: "...Anyway, the three of us, plus
two chosen from Clovis, Arthur, Xiujian and Fain,
will make a team of five.
Touya, I'll leave the choice of those two to you.
Does anyone object?"
Arthur: "No."
Clovis: "Fine by me. Let's decide, then.
...Who'll it be, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh? W-well..."
Choose Clovis & Arthur.
Choose Clovis & Xiujian.
Choose a different pair.
Choose Clovis & Fain.
Choose Arthur & Xiujian.
Choose a different pair.
Choose Arthur & Fain.
Choose Xiujian & Fain.
Choose a different pair.
Clovis: "All right. With me along,
you can consider yourselves aboard a sturdy ship."
Arthur: "Let's hope we don't run aground."
Clovis: "Well, if we do, you're aboard with me."
Arthur: "Then I'd better keep a careful lookout."
Clovis: "Heh... I'm counting on you."
Xiujian: "Understood."
Clovis: "Yeah, leave it to me."
Clovis: "Well, I'm suited to this sort of thing, but..."
Fain: "Hehehehe! An important mission like this
needs me. Leave it all to me! Dahahaha!"
Clovis: "...Good grief. This doesn't bode well."
Xiujian: "Understood."
Arthur: "I'll do my best to meet your expectations."
Ai: "That's a pretty subdued choice of people."
Fain: "All right! Leave it to me! In the name of justice,
I'll bring them down!"
Derock: "...This is the trouble with hot-blooded idiots, you know..."
Fain: "Wh-what did you say?!!"
Derock: "It's the truth. This is a covert operation.
We're supposed to sneak in quietly
and accomplish our objective quickly, you know."
Fain: "Argh, shut up!
Even when you're right, hearing it from you pisses me off!"
Arthur: "Now, now. You've lost this argument.
Please avoid doing anything too conspicuous."
Fain: "G-guh..."
Celica: "For once, Derock has a point."
Derock: "Mhehehehe...
It comes from the spirit of secret photography, you know. Ghyuff! Ghyuff!"
Fain: "..."
Arthur: "..."
Celica: "...Sigh."
Xiujian: "..."
Fain: "Hm? What's wrong? Are you worried?
There's no need to worry.
You've got me with you! Dahahaha!"
Xiujian: "..."
Lodis: "...Right. That's the team decided."
Rest: "Now all that's left is to carry it out.
We have Reamond's information to thank for this..."
Arthur: "Still, it was good of him to tell us.
He even gave us data on the research facility,
despite risking being seen as a traitor..."
Lodis: "Personally, he seems to have wanted us
to cooperate, as we did. Liebhofen
would let us get there quickly, too.
Perhaps he grew anxious when General Growster
chose to deal with it using only his own side.
That's probably why he went out of his way to tell us.
He also said...
'We may not make it in time.'"
Touya: "...What does that mean?"
Lodis: "I don't know. But if we can secure the main 'Code 3' facility,
we should deal them a blow they won't recover from
for at least three years."
Arthur: "And act during that time...?
Will that really be enough?"
Lodis: "I'll make it work.
Besides, it's never too late to start."
Ai: "Exactly. Let's do what we can now
and worry about the rest afterward.
Come on! Let's go!"
Touya: "...Come to think of it, has anything happened here since then?"
Ymir: "During the two days you were unconscious?
Let's see..."
Xiujian: "York forced the Zigrim army to withdraw
and won its liberation."
Touya: "I see. That's good news."
Lodis: "As for York, the Kingdom of Agarthia sent
a personal letter supporting Queen Ciel's accession.
Along with a request."
Touya: "A request?"
Lodis: "More accurately, perhaps I'm making use of them."
Touya: "There you go again... Just say what you mean."
Lodis: "Well, you'll find out soon enough.
I'd rather my worries came to nothing...
More importantly, Touya, how about you?"
Touya: "Yeah. I had a strange dream..."
Lodis: "...I see.
You met Dr. Wenimas... It's hard to believe
at first, but that would explain everything.
Why, all of a sudden,
your existence and that of Clovis and the others became unstable.
And why all of you had such high Prana and fighting instincts.
Why Rayblade, which no one could operate,
accepted you. These things are too much
to dismiss as coincidence..."
Touya: "It really is a crazy story. Wenimas has become
something like a god."
Lodis: "Yes. Also, did that young man you met
say anything else? About brothers,
or someone's name?"
Touya: "Hmm... I don't think he said anything in particular...
Just that the explosion three years ago sent him away, or something
about the depths of despair..."
Lodis: "I-I see... Then it really was... Rayfon...
No, surely not..."
Ymir: "T-Touya, what was Dr. Wenimas
like?"
Touya: "Huh? Well... She was beautiful, like you, Ymir."
Ymir: "I-I see..."
Ai: "Hey, you!
Don't sneak in a pickup line while we're talking!"
Touya: "Y-you idiot! That's not what I meant!"
Ai: "Hmph! If you say so."
Miyasco: "We'll reach the designated point shortly."
Celica: "...Brother, are you really sure? Maybe we should..."
Lodis: "I know it's dangerous. But doing nothing and regretting it
would just be running away. Don't worry. Everyone's with me."
Rest: "I will protect His Majesty
with my life. Please rest assured."
Celica: "You're right. I'm sorry.
...Yes. Do your best."
Rest: "Yes, ma'am. Well then..."
Miyasco: "...Oh, M-Major Rest..."
Rest: "Hm?"
Miyasco: "Um... Have you seen Maki yet...?"
Rest: "No, not yet. As long as she's safe, that's enough.
Besides, I can't put my personal feelings first right now."
Miyasco: "That's true... But..."
Rest: "It's fine. It's time for the operation.
I'll hear you out afterward. Goodbye."
Miyasco: "Rest..."
Touya: "...They've gone.
All we can do is wait...?"
Celica: "Yes. I hope nothing happens..."
Gen: "...This is boring.
I wish something would happen..."
Rosalie: "What are you saying?! Peace is best.
Of course it'd be better
if nothing happened at all!"
Miyasco: "?! This feeling... It can't be..."
Sisk: "...Oh!"
Ymir: "What's wrong?"
Sisk: "L-look!"
Celica: "Armored Mechs?! What about the radar?!"
Sisk: "I-it's working normally! There's nothing on radar!"
Ai: "What?! Don't tell me they've got
optical cloaking too?!"
Celica: "...You're kidding.
Have they managed to miniaturize it enough
to fit it into an Armored Mech...?"
Touya: "Hey, have they noticed us?!"
Ymir: "...We've deployed optical cloaking.
How could they possibly...?"
Rosalie: "Honestly! It's because you said
you wished something would happen!"
Gen: "Ow! It's not my fault!"
Celica: "There doesn't seem to be any doubt. At that range,
they've probably detected our flight vibrations too..."
Kasumi: "Wh-what should we do?"
Touya: "If they've caught on, we can't run.
If we don't deal with them here, Lodis and the others
will be in danger too."
Ai: "...That settles it! Let's go!"
Ymir: "Wait a moment! Are those Armored Mechs really
connected to 'Code 3'?
If we're wrong..."
Miyasco: "...Those units are Rayal Klose...
There's no doubt that 'Code 3' created them."
Celica: "...What?"
Ymir: "Miyasco... You..."
Sisk: "I'm checking the units. There's no matching data!"
Celica: "...It looks like there's no mistake.
In any case, let's deal with them for now!
Sisk, activate area isolation!"
Sisk: "R-roger!"
Celica: "Dealing with those units comes first right now.
But... will you explain everything afterward?"
Miyasco: "...Y-yes."
Touya: "All right! Let's go!"
Ai: "Touya. I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll act alone. You handle things on your end."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I don't intend to follow your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Celica: "I'm sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice does not yet
dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
And so I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Kururu: "I'm going to fight my own way."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow your orders properly,
Touya. So I'll do things my own way this time."

review_batches.context: Read all 365 rows plus s_030/s_031 for separate-route context. Lodis briefs an earlier Code 3 infiltration route after Sisk's adult affectionate fussing. Covert five-person team is Lodis/Rest/Derock plus two selected allies, with Derock's secret-photo gag.
review_batches.decisions: Source-file order is not chronology: current King Lodis and Code 3 facility preparations are not forced to follow the final Debish battle. Keep Sisk's familiar Highness versus formal Majesty, all hearts/music cues, potential facility self-destruction as hypothesis, Lodis's memory claim, three fixed/two selectable/five total count and unlabelled pair choices. Secret-photo contents are unspecified: do not invent nudity, underwear or sexual images. No actual infiltration method beyond the fictional briefing supplied.

row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o000cb.l00: Stretched Highness address and heart retained without extra sexual action.

row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o001d2.l00: Rest's briefing request is deliberately trailing but its direction is explicit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00226.l02: Likely armed is an estimate, not a proven weapon inventory.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00226.l05: Possible self-destruction to erase evidence, not an actual instruction or given mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00345.l02: Clovis doubts special forces are already present; no new troop location asserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o003d5.l01: Arthur's offer deliberately trails off before Lodis challenges his memory.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o0043f.l01: He refers to the data supplier Reamond, identified later; no new source inserted in speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00539.l01: Near-one-view memory is Celica's claim about Lodis, not a diagnostic eidetic-memory label.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00539.l03: Repeated pickup attempts are adult nonexplicit flirting; no sexual acts added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o005d2.l00: Major Rest's rank is established; he accompanies Lodis, not replaces him as leader.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00695.l00: Fixed trio continues into the later two-selected-allies specification.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o006c7.l00: Derock boasts of covert aptitude; no actual stealth technique supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o006c7.l01: Secret photos is the full specified content. No intimate body part, nudity or sexual image is named, so none is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00728.l00: Let-me-see is an elliptical request to view the unspecified photos.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o00759.l00: Pain and incomplete request for photos back, not a new described strike.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o007b8.l01: More prints preserves the duplicability joke; no camera/storage method added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o007fe.l02: Five total, not three plus five.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o0087f.l00: No means no objection, matching the negative English question.

review_batches.context: Same full-member reading. All six pair choices and separate reactions; Fain's justice bluster conflicts with stealth, Derock's sensible objection collapses into photo bragging. Reamond's warning, at-least-three-year project setback estimate, two-day unconscious interval, Queen Ciel support letter and uncertain Rayfon identification.
review_batches.decisions: Keep pair alternatives separate rather than one team containing everyone. English no answers the no-objection question, without reversing assent. Covert-photo gag has no specified sexual content, so none is added. Preserve Reamond motive speculation, warning uncertainty, duration values, hidden purpose of York request, Wenimas recollection and Lodis's tentative Rayfon inference. Do not insert a confirmed identity or resolved chronology from later files.

row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o01346.l00: Two-day unconscious interval retained without merging with every timeline branch.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Letter/dream discussion continues, Wenimas appearance and gentle Ymir teasing, Rest's departure and Miyasco's attempted Maki question. Waiting team sees approaching Armored Mechs absent from radar despite Liebhofen's cloaking.
review_batches.decisions: Maintain letter as support/request, not guaranteed alliance result. Lodis's explanation of earlier anomalies is inference. Preserve failed personal conversation and Maki safety as Rest's condition, not narrator report. Optical-cloaking/miniaturization are characters' hypotheses distinct from radar status; do not add real electronic-warfare mechanisms. Ymir's unfinished detection question stays unfinished.

review_batches.context: Read the full member. Miyasco identifies the Code 3 units; Celica defers questions until combat is resolved. Separate trust-based independent-action responses and repeated soldier breakdown events precede alternative return-to-ship scenes.
review_batches.decisions: Retain every repeated event. Miyasco's identification differs from Sisk's lack of matching data. No gender is assumed for generic soldiers. Independent action is conditional, not one universal mutiny. Celica's flight-vibration detection is tentative; area isolation has no invented technical parameters. Preserve all interrupted questions and name-only reactions.

row_decisions.scenario.s_02f.o0208f.l01: Detection inferred from distance, not confirmed telemetry.

review_batches.context: Full-member context. Separate soldier breakdown/return branches, observed self-destruction delay and Plasma Coating warning.
review_batches.decisions: Self-destruction follows a period without being attacked, approximately three minutes according to Touya; do not reverse the condition or claim native mechanics are proved. Plasma Coating halves melee damage specifically.
